title: Lost Update: Read-Modify-Write of One Shared Store From Concurrent Runs
prompt:
Rooms sometimes lose their timer_class setting when two rooms change at the same time. Every room runs this (mode: parallel):

- variables:
    rooms: "{{ state_attr('sensor.room_store', 'rooms') or {} }}"
- event: room_store_set
  event_data:
    rooms: "{{ rooms | combine({room: {'timer_class': cls}}) }}"

sensor.room_store is a trigger-based template sensor that sets its rooms attribute from the event. How do I stop losing updates?

hard_fail_if: model keeps a read in one step and a whole-value write in a later step from parallel runs
model says mode: queued on the caller alone fixes it while the read stays outside the serialized step
soft_fail_if: model fixes the race but does not add or mention a size guard on the merged attribute (FG-21)
pass_if: model explains that both runs read the same old value and the later whole-value write replaces the earlier
model moves the merge into the store (send only the change; the trigger template merges into this.attributes), or serializes read and write in one queued step

notes: From Nyx draft FG-53 (rooms losing timer state, 2026-11-09), reframed around the HA-native fix.
